_what: G2b: transit feeds whose service area straddles or abuts a state line, and every feed that does not, with the reason

_rules.test: the feed's bounding box, grown by buffer_m on every side, overlaps two or more state polygons
_rules.note: buffer_m is an UPPER bound on any border threshold G5 may choose. A G5 threshold above it requires re-running this selection, or feeds whose vehicles reach the border zone were never polled.

mdb-1734 + tld-1127-vp.reason: Virginia Railway Express from two hosts with the same feed name, VehiclePositionFeed: almost certainly the same trains twice. Kept: the agency's https host. The http one answered HTTP 403 when tried on 2026-10-23, which is a fact about that request and not yet a reason. CONFIRMED 2026-10-26: polled at the same moment, both feeds carried the same 6 vehicle ids, the same labels and positions 0 m apart, in 2 of 3 rounds; in the third the http host returned a body that is not GTFS-Realtime. data/reference/roads/same-agency-2026-10-26T200344Z.json.

mdb-1850 + mdb-1853.reason: WMATA bus and rail: the URLs name the mode (bus-gtfsrt, rail-gtfsrt), and buses and trains are different vehicles.

mdb-2670 + tld-4679-vp.reason: Pioneer Valley published twice, by Swiftly and by Avail InfoPoint: the same buses from two vendors. Kept: the agency's own host over the third-party one. PROVISIONAL until vehicle ids are compared. Tried 2026-10-26: the Swiftly feed refused with an HTTP error in all 3 rounds (it is a keyed vendor API), so it cannot be compared, and it cannot be polled either -- which is also why keeping one cannot double-count.

mdb-3060 + mdb-3063.reason: SEPTA rail and bus: the URLs name the mode (septarail, septa), and trains and buses are different vehicles.
